page.layout: One printed page, title page: centred lines of text from top to bottom, with a woodcut ornament and a date line below; library stamps and ink seals on the right, not transcribed.

main_text.l: necessarius, in quo ex linguarum & priscae variaque
quos Academiae observant, & quae eo pertinent,

page.notes: Ornamental woodcut between the "CATALOGVS." line and the place name, not transcribed. Library stamps (oval "BIBLIOTHECA ... ROMA" stamp, circular stamp and blue seal) on the right are omitted. The date is printed as "clo, Io. xxcvii" in the old reversed-C form, rendered as MDXCVII in Roman numerals per the convention; the printed form reads clo, Io, which I have kept as the reading of the scan. Dropped capitals and spacing in the title are as printed.
